name: memories
source:
memories is a sapphic visual novel dress-up game where clothes are linked to painful memories of a failed relationship.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《memories》是一部女性同性恋题材的视觉小说换装游戏。每一件衣服，都连着一段关于失败恋情的痛苦回忆。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219470/]Steam[/url]]
